visual_description: Since the very start I saw different visual patterns that changed quickly. I didn't know if those would classify as hallucinations, so in the beginning I didn't press space for at least 30s, maybe more. The patterns I saw changed quickly in the beginning, then more and more I started seeing rotating patterns, like a tornado, with the color extending out of the screen a little bit. When I blinked my eyes, the hallucination usually became less prominent, or even disappeared. I could also stop the hallucination without having to blink, if so I wished.   I got a little anxious, thinking if it could trigger some mental health problem, some thoughts about that run through my mind. At some point while that was happening, I started seeing contours that resembled contours of a face.   Later I saw some more localized patterns. I think that mostly at the right part of the screen and probably more at the bottom.   At some point my eyes seemed to get a little dry, so I blinked a lot. I had no hallucinations for a bit. Then I tried to get back to having hallucinations. I started having a little more again, but less pronounced. Eventually I saw some other colors other than black and red. I think I saw white, yellow and orange, for the whole screen.  At the very end I started feeling relaxed. I even wondered if my eyes were closing a little bit. Once in a while, when I was a little more alert I opened my eyes a little more. At those times I had a more "realistic" (less distorted) view of the screen.  When the white screen came with the message saying it was over, it seemed very bright.
duration_visual: Constant, morphing from one image to the next
emotional_experience: No feeling about it one way or the other
consciousness_description: I felt sleepy, a little drowsy. My eyes seemed to be closing, as if I was falling asleep. I had to consciously prevent myself from not falling asleep.

visual_description: In the beginning of it I felt very aware that there was a screen, but about a minute or two in the screen almost split in two and then looked almost like a black hole in the middle. That went on for a bit and then later in the experiment I experienced almost a hurricane sensation where the entire room felt like it was spinning and the screen was wrapping around my head and spinning the top portion of the room. During this I also experienced seeing stars, maybe they were just white dots but it looked like I was in a whirl of space with stars all around me. The spinning spiral was tilted towards the right corner of the room, and it spun for the majority of the time that I was in the room. Then, it felt like the screen was moving towards me and the "hurricane" spinning was coming closer to my face.

visual_description: I saw three main things, in three separate sections. The first things I started to see were spiderweb-like lines that were not colored, but were moreso lighter/darker over the red/black flickering. The spider-web lines felt almost like a tunnel based on how they were shaped, like it was the inside view of a cylinder made up of the spider-web lines. It also felt like it was moving in a way where the cylindrical structure of the lines were part of the tunnel that was either coming towards or away from what I was seeing. The second part was the most hallucinations I saw in a short period of time. The screen started growing, and it was still just the red/black flash but the screen felt like it was slowly getting bigger, and there were moments were I was fully immersed into the screen like there was nothing else around it, and the screen didn't stop looking like it was growing until that section of my hallucinations ended. The last part, I saw directional lines that were moving towards the curves they were pointing to. The lines were alternating between left to right and right to left from top to bottom. This one is a bit hard to explain with words but I drew this on the paper, as well as the tunnel spider-web thing. It's also notable that I saw cyan occasionally throughout the whole time in small moments.
emotional_experience: Somewhat enjoyable, but easy to stop

visual_description: First I saw a red right tilted vertical short line in the lower right quadrant of the screen, that went on for a little bit. The line was sometimes stable and sometimes flickering. The light from the eye tracker was distracting as that square with the red lights was kind of part of the screen. The square with the square red little lights from the eye tracker was moving with the flickering, up, down, to the sides and towards me. Screen looked sometimes bigger and sometimes smaller. It was overall overwhelming. Then when I blinked I saw black screen with lots of green bubbles. Back on the screen I saw lines now in yellow in the same position as the red one was. Then I saw almost like a wrapping motion of the red light on the side of the screen, where it looked like a firework almost shooting out from the left lower quadrant towards the upper right one. Then this stopped and I saw more red lines, now in upper left quadrant, looking like a double cross, four lines total, all red. The most exciting part was to see the screen more a little towards me and form a red and yellow spiral in the middle of the screen that was almost shooting red and yellow light out of the screen - somewhat like fire again. The yellow residue of faster and faster moving spiral spread across the whole screen. Shortly I saw another cross in the top right and then just the red lines moving up and down the whole screen. These red lines were moving around the screen almost at all times, aside from the sections when I looked at specific shapes, such lines would be mostly vertical, sometimes horizontal, and lesser times diagonal, would move up and down mostly and towards me.
